summary: create-design draw stage never gives to-be agents the recorded brief item ids, so a wrong id is only caught by validate at step 5, after the whole draw, with no recovery step
audit-design verdict: a to-be board serving no brief item yields only a caveat, never do-not-proceed (policy call)
audit-design counts superseded and as-is boards as serving a brief item, so an item served only by a superseded board raises no no-board finding (tested as intended; policy call)
